summary: A 29-year-old woman drowned when a non-commercial raft with seven occupants overturned on the Poudre River near mile marker 95 on Highway 14 ~7:41 p.m.; she was pulled from the water unresponsive and did not survive despite life-saving efforts
responding_agency: Larimer County Sheriff's Office; Larimer County Search and Rescue
notes: DATE PINNED: year inferred from the article's search-index last-updated metadata (~4107 days before 2026-09-12, i.e. 2014 publication) plus the June-14 story date; 2014-06-14 was a Saturday.
